candidates.mechanism: Static mean-intensity analytic wait; one bay per lane; ordinary FCFS recurrent fleet.
candidates.applicability: Transparent stationary reference; intentionally ignores flight-phase variation.
candidates.failure_expectation: Time-varying arrivals distort queue wait; safe minimum bays may underuse capacity.

candidates.mechanism: NHPP Gamma inverse Monte Carlo expected wait; finite bay empirical-capacity maximization; deficit-sized short-trip credit with quota and aging.
candidates.applicability: Conditional assumed intensity, geometry and closed-fleet scenarios.
candidates.failure_expectation: Unobserved parameter error and demand correlation may dominate MC accuracy; credit may not improve fairness.

candidates.mechanism: Deterministic cumulative-intensity fluid threshold; fixed three bays per lane; fixed-delay short-trip aging promotion.
candidates.applicability: Structural control without stochastic wait estimation or deficit-sized credit.
candidates.failure_expectation: Inverse-of-mean differs from mean inverse; fixed credit promotion can trade fairness against waits.
